# Find maximum and minimum voltage buses

min_bus_index = np.argmin(ssa.Bus.v.v)

    "min_bus": ssa.Bus.idx.v[min_bus_index],
    "min_voltage": round(ssa.Bus.v.v[min_bus_index], 6),
    "total_pq_count": len(ssa.PQ.idx.v)
}
